question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
WITH visit_purchases AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT visit_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events
    WHERE page_id = 13 AND event_type = 3
),
visit_product_actions AS (
    SELECT 
        e.visit_id,
        p.product_id,
        e.event_type
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE e.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
)
SELECT 
    p.product_id,
    p.page_name AS product_name,
    p.product_category,
    SUM(CASE WHEN vpa.event_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS view_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN vpa.event_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS add_to_cart_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN vpa.event_type = 2 AND vp.visit_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN vpa.event_type = 2 AND vp.visit_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS left_in_cart_count
FROM visit_product_actions vpa
JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON vpa.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN visit_purchases vp ON vpa.visit_id = vp.visit_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.page_name, p.product_category
ORDER BY p.product_id
